title: Quantitative Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) Analysis of Family C

cycle_a_attack_properties.schedule: 1 attack step, 10 rest steps (1:10 duty cycle = 1/11 = 0.0909)

fundamental_snr_disparity.diagnosis: The time-averaged input rate of Cycle A (0.0518) is less than half the ambient benign noise rate (0.1169). Because the adversary spends 90.9% of time resting, the ambient telemetry dominates the state of the leaky accumulator Q_t. To prevent false quarantine on ambient noise, tau_Q was set to 4.4364, leaving Cycle A (peak Q = 3.12) completely sub-threshold.
